reason.en: The official summary says Proposition 30 "Increases taxes on earnings over $250,000 for seven years and sales taxes by ¼ cent for four years, to fund schools."

sourceTitle.en: Official Voter Information Guide, November 6, 2012 General Election: Proposition 30

summary.en: Raised personal income taxes on earnings over $250,000 for seven years and the sales tax by ¼ cent for four years to fund schools, and guaranteed public safety realignment funding.

title.en: Temporary Taxes to Fund Education. Guaranteed Local Public Safety Funding. Initiative Constitutional Amendment.
